title.en: Gone with the Scooter: the story in brief

text.en: On a summer afternoon Gopi hears a thud in the garden and finds a white hockey ball in dry leaves.

It was a summer afternoon. Gopi was reading on the veranda when something fell with a thud in the garden. He thought it was a mango.
He searched the grass by the fence and the bushes and finally found a white hockey ball in a heap of dry leaves.
His mother called him in because of the heat. He decided he could not keep the ball and would ask around.
In the evening at the playground he asked his friends. Manoj had lost a ball four months before. Ramani claimed it jokingly. Deepak bragged about his new football.
Manoj grabbed the ball and tossed it to Deepak. Gopi told them to stop and play before it got dark.
They began a game. Jay hit the ball so hard that it flew past the gate and landed in the basket of a passing scooter. The scooterist did not notice, and the scooter went away with the ball. The children looked at each other and burst out laughing.

problem.en: What happened to the ball at the end?

text.en: Jay hit it hard.
It flew out of the gate.
It fell into a scooter basket and went away.
